retry_when: score is below the manifest quality threshold
improvement_policy.stop_when: the same external blocker repeats and the exact blocker is recorded in review.json and gate.json

model_policy.complex: Codex: gpt-5.6-sol with xhigh reasoning; other hosts: deepest_reasoning tier.
dispatch_contract: Before each eligible agent dispatch, use the route matching the current effective difficulty.
On Codex, pass the route's model and reasoning_effort as explicit dispatch overrides.
On another host, choose a concrete available model matching the route tier and record it.
Do not silently use a weaker route.

fallback.action: Use the strongest available model at the same tier or higher.
fallback.allowed_when: The selected model or reasoning effort is unavailable to the host.

model_policy.moderate: Codex: gpt-5.6-sol with high reasoning; other hosts: deep_reasoning tier.

complex.use_when: Security-sensitive, architectural, large, or ambiguous work.

moderate.use_when: Cross-file behavior, quality-gate, or template contract changes.

simple.use_when: Localized, low-risk work with bounded verification.

model_policy.simple: Codex: gpt-5.6-terra with medium reasoning; other hosts: balanced tier.

subagent_policy.complex: Dispatch only taskgraph-selected waves; split implementer work only when dependencies and resource sets are disjoint, then keep one integration owner.
subagent_policy.moderate: Keep implementation in the primary agent and run explicit reviewer and verifier passes.

task_graph_policy.role_routing: task explicit role, then manifest route, then workflow default
task_graph_policy.single_writer: Use harness taskgraph transitions for tasks.json state changes.

risks: Cloudflare deployment, D1 migrations, and Vectorize changes can affect shared organization-memory services.

success_criteria: Interactive Codex Claude Code and Cursor use Access OAuth; hook credentials are independently enrollable and revocable per machine-client; no raw conversations or secrets are stored; focused and full manifest checks pass
